references.text: David speaks of the blessing of forgiveness, which is relevant to the context of Jesus forgiving sins in Mark 2:6.
God declares His ability to forgive sins, reflecting Jesus' actions and authority in Mark 2:6.
This verse parallels Mark 2:6 by showing the scribes' reaction to Jesus forgiving sins.
Similar to Mark 2:6, the scribes and Pharisees question Jesus' authority to forgive sins.
Hebrews encourages approaching God's throne with confidence, reflecting Jesus' authority and ability to forgive sins as shown in Mark 2:6.
